rationales.rationale: FINRA BrokerCheck is the authoritative, free, public registry of all U.S.-registered broker-dealers. Three named subsidiaries should each return a CRD record with status 'Approved' and SEC# present.

name: fdic_bankfind.query_institution
description: FDIC BankFind Suite institution registry; resolves an institution name/cert/RSSDID and returns charter class, primary regulator, status, and headquarters.

rationales.rationale: OCC national-bank charter status, primary federal regulator, and FDIC insurance status are authoritative registry attributes that the FDIC BankFind Suite resolves directly by institution name.

name: sec_abs15g.query_securitizer_filings
description: SEC EDGAR ABS-15G / ABS-EE filings registry. Returns asset-backed securitizer disclosures (repurchase activity, pool composition) per CIK with filing date and document URLs.
completeness: All SEC-registered ABS securitizers (federally registered offerings only; 144A private deals partially covered via Form D)

rationales.rationale: Loan-platform third-party origination volume should flow through whole-loan-sale or ABS issuance channels; ABS-15G filings disclose securitizer repurchase activity and pool composition at the asset-pool level, providing a registry analog for claimed origination/transfer volume that catalog's edgar_fts.query_fulltext can only count, not parse.

name: fhfa_fhlb.query_member_advances
description: FHFA Federal Home Loan Bank member-advance disclosures and call-report-derived advance balances per member institution.
sample_invocation: GET https://www.fhfa.gov/sites/default/files/data-files/fhlb-members.csv  (filter on member_name=='SoFi Bank, National Association')
completeness: All FHLB member banks (FDIC-insured depository institutions and certain insurance companies)

rationales.rationale: FHLB membership and advance balances are reported by FHFA at the member-institution level; this is the authoritative registry for the FHLB-borrowing-capacity claim that the catalog's fdic_call_reports can only proxy via balance-sheet 'other borrowings'.

name: fdic_call_reports.consumer_loan_originations
description: FDIC Call Report consumer-loan origination volume per institution (RSSDID-keyed quarterly schedules RC-C / RI). Lets analysts see whether named UPST partner banks (Cross River Bank, FinWise Bank, Customers Bank, etc.) show unsecured personal-loan portfolio levels consistent with UPST's reported 83% origination concentration.
completeness: FDIC-chartered banks only (Cross River, FinWise, Customers, etc. are covered; non-bank purchasers are not)

rationales.rationale: UPST does not name its top lending partners in the 10-K, but bank-partner Call Reports are the registry analog: if UPST's claimed 83% origination concentration is accurate, the partner banks' consumer-loan portfolios should reflect material UPST volume. This is the closest authoritative federal registry to consumer-credit origination concentration.

name: sec_edgar.absee_loan_disclosures
description: SEC EDGAR Asset-Backed Securities issuer reports (ABS-EE / 10-D / 424B) including loan-tape XML/XBRL exhibits. UPST is a sponsor of multiple securitization shelves; pool-level outstanding-balance data is filed periodically.
sample_invocation: GET https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001647639.json then filter forms ABS-EE/10-D/424B5; sum pool_principal_balance across active trusts.
completeness: SEC-registered ABS only; private-pool sales and whole-loan sales to lending partners are not covered

rationales.rationale: UPST-serviced loans flowing through securitizations are visible in ABS-EE filings (per Regulation AB) — total outstanding balance across all UPST-sponsored trusts is the registry analog for the serviced-portfolio claim. Applies Calibration Heuristic 3: 'serviced' vs 'originated' vs 'balance-sheet' must not be confused.

name: nv_sos.query_entity
description: Nevada Secretary of State business entity search (SilverFlume) — returns entity status, formation date, entity type, and registered agent for a corporate name.
sample_invocation: POST businessSearch with {entityName: 'Affirm Holdings, Inc.'} ; parse status, NV file number, formation/conversion date.

rationales.rationale: Reincorporation is a state-registry event; the only authoritative adjudicator is the destination state's Secretary-of-State business registry. EDGAR shows the filing but not the actual state record that the conversion took legal effect.

name: nfa_basic.query_swap_dealer_registration
description: NFA BASIC registry: provisional and full CFTC swap-dealer registration lookup by firm name or NFA ID
completeness: all CFTC-registered swap dealers and major swap participants

rationales.rationale: CFTC swap-dealer registration is an authoritative, publicly searchable registry maintained by the National Futures Association under CFTC delegation. Claim is binary (registered/not) and registry-adjudicable.

name: nmls.query_consumer_access
description: NMLS Consumer Access — Nationwide Multistate Licensing System public registry for state-licensed mortgage companies and individual MLOs.
sample_invocation: GET https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/Home.aspx/CompanySearch with name='Opendoor' -> parse company-detail page for state licenses and license-status fields
completeness: All state-licensed non-bank mortgage companies and individual MLOs (NMLS-participating states, which is all 50)

rationales.rationale: State mortgage-origination licensing has no SEC analog; NMLS is the authoritative public registry for non-bank mortgage lender licensing status across all 50 states.

name: argentina_compras.query_public_tenders
description: Argentine federal procurement portal COMPR.AR / Contrataciones del Estado tender registry. Returns public-sector tenders awarded by Banco de la Nación Argentina (a state-owned bank), including vendor name and contract value.
completeness: Argentine federal public-sector procurement only; provincial coverage incomplete

rationales.rationale: Banco Nación is a state-owned Argentine bank; vendor selections for core-banking modernization at state banks typically appear in the federal procurement registry. Provides authoritative independent confirmation of the named-partnership claim that the catalog cannot adjudicate.

name: pacer.federal_court_docket
description: PACER federal-court case docket lookup. Returns case caption, filing date, current status, certifying orders for a specific federal civil case number.

rationales.rationale: The class-action existence, caption, court, and certification-order date are public PACER record; CourtListener's RECAP archive provides keyless free access. EDGAR full-text would only find UPST's own self-disclosure, which would be circular.

name: pacer.query_case_docket
description: Federal court PACER docket retrieval for case-status and final-judgment verification on named civil cases.
endpoint: https://pcl.uscourts.gov/pcl/index.jsf (PACER Case Locator) and per-court CM/ECF (e.g. https://ecf.azd.uscourts.gov)
sample_invocation: PACER Case Locator search court=azd, case_no=2:22-CV-01717-MTL -> CM/ECF docket pull -> filter for 'Final Judgment' entry; alternatively use CourtListener RECAP archive (https://www.courtlistener.com/api/rest/v3/dockets/?docket_number=2:22-cv-01717) as a free mirror.
estimated_cost: $0.10/page on PACER; free via CourtListener RECAP
completeness: All federal district / appellate court cases; bankruptcy and state cases excluded

rationales.rationale: Securities-class-action final disposition is an authoritative status only court dockets adjudicate; SEC filings are issuer-prepared and therefore self-referential. CourtListener / RECAP provides a free public mirror sufficient for binary final-judgment confirmation.
